text:
Maya: Quick sync  Launch in 8 days. Proposal: pause the weekly, run a lean launch drip, AND switch the newsletter to dynamic modules (benchmarks vs embeddings use-cases) for the engaged cohort. Thoughts?
Priya: love dynamic modules. lets show 1) benchmarks, 2) production tips, 3) customer quote. only render modules based on inferred product interest tag (embeddings vs generation).
Sam: agree pause + dynamic modules. also recommend a short re-engage sequence for low-engagers before pruning. keep it 2 emails max.
Evan: ops question  can ESP handle conditional modules by tag at scale? what's the tag list?
ops: yes ESP supports conditional blocks. we'll need a CSV with email + tag set. propose tags: "interest:embeddings", "interest:generation", "interest:inference-costs". ops can merge.
Priya: re-engage copy plan: Day0 = "Quick update from Redwood" (A/B subject), Day3 = "Three low-latency tips". If no opens after 30d -> tag `sunset_launch2026`.
Maya: important exclusions: paying customers, trial in last 365d, webinar RSVPs, partners list, and anyone with snooze_opt_out.
Jules: let's also test content order: for embeddings-interested folks show case study first; for generation-interested show benchmark first. small A/B to measure module CTR.
Sam: send-window split: 10am vs 2pm local for engaged cohort. re-engage to be global at 11am PT.
Evan: SQL we can run for tag export:
```sql
SELECT id, email,
 CASE
  WHEN product_tags @> '{"embeddings"}' THEN 'interest:embeddings'
  WHEN product_tags @> '{"generation"}' THEN 'interest:generation'
  ELSE 'interest:general'
 END AS interest_tag
FROM newsletter_subscribers
WHERE status='subscribed'
  AND snooze_opt_out = false
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customers WHERE customers.email = newsletter_subscribers.email AND customers.trial_started_at > now() - interval '365 days');
```
Maya: timeline & actions:
- Priya: finalize module copy + subject lines by tomorrow 10:00.
- Sam: define A/B matrix (module order + subject + send-time) by tomorrow noon.
- Evan/ops: deliver tagged CSV and suppression list by tomorrow EOD.
- Ops: implement `sunset_launch2026` suppression for 30d no-open after re-engage.
marketing-bot: Campaign created "dynamic_newsletter_launch_2026" id cm_2026_dynamic_01  modules pending.
Priya: I'll add the module mockups to the doc and include alt text for gen vs embed audiences.
Maya: Great. If no objections by EOD we proceed with pause+dynamic+re-engage+sunset.
Sam: thumbs up.
Evan: starting export job now. will post link when ready.
